messages:
Nina V: Proposal: emit provisional 'inflight' ledger items when final token events are delayed >8m so preview reflects likely cost. Label them provisional and reconcile later.

Kevin L: Match using provenance_id header or client_req_id. If absent, use fingerprint but mark as fallback.

Priya S: Console: show 'Provisional' badge, filter ?provisional=true, and internal "Force settle" with audit comment. Hide provisionals from external exports by default.

Maya R: Ledger API: add provisional:boolean, provenance_id, match_type, estimate_tokens, provisional_ttl. Reconcile endpoint supporting commit|adjust|void and idempotent PATCH semantics.

Kevin L: Metrics: billing.inflight_provisional_emitted, billing.inflight_reconciled_total, billing.inflight_delta_p95. Alert if reconcile_delta_pct_p95 > 2%.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: billing-service v2.40.0 deployed to staging; feature flag billing.inflight_provisionals=false.

Nina V: I'll draft the design doc and open PRs for schema & console. Ping @Kevin L @Priya S for review.
